description: The routing criteria action: update_contact_routing_criteria with routing_criteria an object holding steps, a list of three objects, each expression written with jsonencode and Flow language keys in byte order (two AndExpressions of two AttributeConditions each, and an AttributeCondition whose Value is a JSONPath), ProficiencyLevel an HCL number, the first two steps with an expiry object whose duration_in_seconds is the integerString written as a number, the last without one, and the catch-all; the same type with the whole of its RoutingCriteria a JSONPath, which the service accepts where it refuses Steps as one (actions.md, rule 45) and an object attribute cannot hold, as a generic block; and update_contact_target_queue with a JSONPath queue and transfer_contact_to_queue around them. No refs: a predefined attribute is named by a string. Awaits the provider release that carries this block (tasks/D10), so it has no validate directory yet.
